_doc: Life-sim core data. births: birth rafts (standing, stat mods, family jobs, starting rep). careers: ranks, pay per rank (scrap/yr), skill stat, minAge, req (Life.meets), standing they impose, reputation shifts, risk + hazards. activities: things you can do once per action slot. world: quiet-year lines, news, heirs, death texts. scenes: hybrid 3D moments.

portage.name: Portage
portage.intro: The loudest raft in the Drift. Your first sound is somebody haggling over the price of salt.

greentide.name: Greentide
greentide.intro: Born under a rain-catcher. The first thing you smell is wet soil, which most people on Earth never smell again.

rusthold.name: Rusthold
rusthold.intro: Born on a welded oil-rig raft. The forge is the warmest place, so that is where they put you.

vigil.name: The Vigil
vigil.intro: Born by candlelight on the faith raft. The Keeper puts a drop of seawater on your tongue, as she does for everyone.

lowlight.name: Lowlight
lowlight.intro: Born in the fog sea, on a raft that isn't on any chart. Your mother names you in a whisper, out of habit.

drifter.name: a Drifter boat
drifter.intro: Born on a boat with no raft to tie to. The whole sea is your neighbourhood, and none of it is friendly.

deepborn.name: the Deep-Born crews
deepborn.intro: Born to a dive crew. They tie a tally cord to your wrist before they tie anything else.

highmark_ring.name: Highmark's lower ring
highmark_ring.intro: Born on dry land, in the lowest ring of Highmark, where the gutters still flood every spring. A blue band is fastened to your wrist.

deckhand.name: Raft crew
hazards: A line parts under load and the end catches you across the ribs.

fisher.name: Fishing
hazards: A swell takes the boat sideways. You come home with nothing but bruises.

engineer.name: Engineering
hazards: A weld spits. You will carry the scar.

mechanic.name: Mechanics
hazards: An engine block shifts. You keep the finger, just about.

smuggler.name: Smuggling
hazards: A Ward searchlight finds you. You lose the cargo and a tooth.

thief.name: Thievery
hazards: Caught with your hand in a locker. The raft votes. You spend a season scrubbing hulls.

ward_deckhand.name: The Tide Ward
hazards: A raid on a smuggler raft goes wrong in the fog.

diver.name: Diving
hazards: You come up too fast. For a week your joints sing.
Your line fouls in a stairwell. You get out. Something in you stays down there.

salvager.name: Salvage
hazards: A floor gives way in a drowned office.

seeker.name: Cathedral seeking
hazards: You hear the Choir for a whole night and cannot speak for three days.

meet: They share half a ration bar without being asked.
They laugh at the wrong moment, and so do you.
They are mending a net badly. You show them the knot.
They tell you a joke about Highmark that would get you both searched.
talk: You sit on the edge of the raft and say nothing important for an hour.
% tells you about a dream with dry streets in it.
You trade complaints about the weather like coins.
% asks how you are, and waits for the real answer.
gift: % turns the gift over in their hands for a long time.
You give % a scrap of real glass. They try not to look as pleased as they are.
A tin of fish, still sealed. % holds it like a baby.
argue: It starts with rations. It ends with things neither of you can take back.
% says you're more Deep-Born than raft-born. They mean it as a cut. It is one.
You argue about Highmark until the lanterns go out.
share: You split your week's ration with %. They don't thank you. They don't need to.
You leave half your water at %'s door.
romanceYes: % kisses you behind the rain-catcher. The rain doesn't mind.
% says yes before you've finished asking.
romanceNo: % looks at your wrist, then at the floor. 'I can't. My family...'
% laughs, kindly, and that is worse.
Not yet, says %. Maybe not ever.
marry: You marry % on the water at dusk. Everyone you love is there, and some people you don't.
A quiet wedding with % on a borrowed barge. The Keeper ties your wrists together with blue thread.
child: Small and loud and furious at the cold.
They have your eyes and your bad timing.
The midwife says they'll be a diver. Everyone says that about every baby.
leave: You leave on a grey morning with one bag.
It ends quietly. That's almost the worst part.
reconcile: You share a pipe on the stern and the old thing between you finally sinks.
% says 'I missed you, you idiot,' and that's that.
betray: You sell %'s name to a Warden for scrap. You tell yourself everybody does.
You take what % trusted you with. The raft finds out. Rafts always find out.

out.text: Rope climbs and swims until you shake.
You pull something in your shoulder.
You read waterlogged manuals until they make sense.
The Vigil's library has a map of the old coast. You trace it with a finger.
You light a candle and put it on the water. It doesn't sink.
In the quiet, you hear something far below that is not quiet at all.
A good dive. Copper and a jar of buttons.
Smooth warm glass in a drowned kitchen.
Your air runs short in a stairwell. You get out. You don't sleep much.
The bones fall your way. Twice.
The bones don't love you tonight.
Ivo listens to your chest and gives you something bitter.
There's nothing to be done, he says, but rest.
You trade a stolen permit stamp for a jar of real honey.
A Ward informer is working the stalls. You leave fast, empty-handed.
You re-lash Low Row's lines in the rain. Nobody asked. Everybody noticed.
You teach a kid to tie a bowline. She ties it wrong forever, proudly.
You take the boat out with no plan and come back at dusk with salt in your hair.

free.title: Out on the water
free.desc: Free roam the Lantern Ward. Return when you like.

first_dive.title: First dive
first_dive.desc: Under Linden Court the lobby is flooded. Dive, find something worth carrying, and come back up.

festival.title: Lantern night
festival.desc: Dusk on Portage. Find the Exchange and set a lantern on the water for someone.

patrol_stop.title: Fog and searchlights
patrol_stop.desc: Night, fog, a Tide Ward launch hunting by engine noise. Hide (cut the engine with C, get behind something) or face the inspection.

storm.title: The night Low Row tore loose
storm.desc: Midnight storm. A raft has broken its lines. Get a tow line on it and bring it home.

quarantine_dive.title: Ward 9
quarantine_dive.desc: The sealed quarantine wing of St. Aldren. Down the service shaft into the flooded basement, to where the growth glows. Then back up.

quietYears: A year of mending nets and waiting for rain.
Nothing much happens. That is its own kind of luck.
The raft drifts a little south. So do you.
You spend the year being exactly who you were.
The Beacon turns. The tide comes and goes. You get a year older.
A grey year. Someone you don't know dies; someone you don't know is born.
worldNews: Highmark announces a new ration seal design. Old seals are void by spring.
A storm season like nobody remembers. Two small rafts are never seen again.
The glow is seen from the surface off the Wrecklands for the first time in years.
Raft Free Voice goes silent for a month, then comes back angrier.
Greentide's harvest fails. Kelp goes to three scrap a bundle.
A Ward captain resigns and joins Lowlight. The radio says he drowned.
Somebody paints HIGHMARK LIES on the Beacon's harbour wall. Twice.
heirs: a woman everyone calls Second Keeper

deaths.illness: Your body simply runs out, the way lamps do.
deaths.old age: You die in your sleep, old, on the water. Someone puts a lantern out for you.
deaths.storm: The storm takes you. They never find the boat.
deaths.deep: You go down past the Dark Shelf and do not come back up. The tally on your sleeve stops at that number.
deaths.patrol: A Ward boarding goes badly. It is written down as an accident.
deaths.hush: The Hush comes back for one more. You lose your voice first. You are not afraid, at the end. You are listening.
deaths.drowned: The water was always going to have you. It is gentle about it.
